contactDeletion.title: Delete contact?
contactDeletion.description: This removes the contact and permanently deletes its message history on this device. This cannot be undone. Fresh online discovery will add the contact back without restoring deleted history.
contactDeletion.online: This contact is online. Only offline contacts can be deleted.
contactDeletion.error: Deletion could not be completed. Some local history may already have been removed. Check that the contact is still offline, then try again.

privacy.relayHelp: Offline delivery requires a manually allowed trusted relay account. Missing verified sender identity is rejected; old relay versions may not support delivery while invisible.
privacy.title: Invisible mode
privacy.description: Stop public presence announcements. Keep seeing other online contacts.
privacy.permissionHelp: Allowed accounts can reach you while invisible. Starting a direct conversation also grants reply permission. Existing joined groups keep group-only access.
privacy.localOnly: Saved for the signed-in user on this device, including offline accounts. Not synced to other devices.
privacy.enableHelp: Unapproved contacts cannot start direct messages or calls. You can still contact them; doing so allows replies. Existing groups remain available.
privacy.limits: This controls presence and communication, not IP anonymity. Previously sent packets and a network port scan cannot be hidden.
privacy.revokeHelp: While invisible, this account loses direct access. History is kept and shared-group access is unchanged. Contacting them again grants a new reply permission.
privacy.loadError: Could not load network privacy. Controls stay disabled; retry to read the saved policy.
privacy.saveError: Could not save the change. The previous permission remains in effect; retry.

contactVisibility.title: Hidden contacts
contactVisibility.settingsDesc: Keep selected contacts out of your lists.
contactVisibility.description: Hides all devices of this account from contact lists and direct-message search. History is kept. Messages and calls can still arrive; shared groups are unchanged.
contactVisibility.localOnly: Saved on this device. Linked devices can share this choice when Contacts sync is enabled on both.
contactVisibility.loadError: Could not load contact visibility. Retry to display contacts safely.
contactVisibility.saveError: Could not save. Your saved contact visibility has not changed.
contactVisibility.allHidden: All contacts are hidden. Restore them in Settings.

common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Check clipboard access and try again.

avatar.galleryHint: Choose an image from the library.

crop.title: Crop photo
crop.description: Drag to reposition and zoom to frame your photo.
crop.viewportLabel: Drag to reposition the photo, or use the arrow keys. Hold Shift for larger steps

login.accountCreated: Account created — you can sign in now.
login.macAuthGuidance: Your Mac’s Touch ID or login password unlocks Mesh-Talk after it locks. Set up Touch ID in macOS System Settings; no separate app setup is needed.
login.footer: Your keys never leave this device. Peers are discovered on your LAN.

recovery.exportIntro: Save a portable copy of your account and local history. You will need a separate recovery key to restore it.
recovery.included: Includes account identity, visible messages, read-only channel history, file cards, locally managed media, and received avatars.
recovery.excluded: Excludes local UI customizations and settings, old device keys, pending deliveries, network settings, and files stored outside Mesh-Talk.
recovery.pauseNotice: Messaging pauses briefly while the backup is made.
recovery.saveKey: Save this recovery key separately from the backup file.
recovery.perExportKey: Each backup has its own key. Mesh-Talk does not store it.
recovery.confirmGroups: Enter groups 2 and 7, separated by a dash, to confirm you saved the key.
recovery.restoreIntro: Choose a backup and enter its matching recovery key. Nothing is installed until you confirm.
recovery.missingMedia: {{count}} file cards have no local media bytes
recovery.newerMissing: Messages newer than this backup may be missing. Peer sync cannot restore channel messages that were not in the backup.
recovery.oldDeviceRisk: An old device may be lost or in someone else’s hands.
recovery.compromiseWarning: Restoring keeps the old account identity. It cannot revoke an old device. If it may be compromised, create a new identity and ask contacts to verify it.
recovery.newDeviceNote: Restore creates a new device identity. Existing local accounts are never merged.
recovery.signInNext: Sign in with your new local credentials.
recovery.noBackup: No backup recorded on this device.
recovery.restoreHint: To restore a backup, sign out and choose recovery on the sign-in screen.

conversation.archivedChannelHint: This is a read-only archive restored from your backup. Ask the channel owner to invite this new device for future messages. Peers cannot decrypt missing old channel history for it.
conversation.dissolvedChannelHint: The owner dissolved this channel. You can read its history, but cannot send new messages.
conversation.leftChannelHint: You left this channel. Your local history remains here, but you cannot send new messages.
conversation.pendingInviteHint: Accept this invitation to join the channel and read new messages.
conversation.declineInviteConfirm: Decline this invitation and leave the channel?
conversation.noneSelectedDesc: Pick a contact or channel to start chatting.
conversation.unlockingDesc: Decrypting keys and starting peer discovery.
conversation.startFailedDesc: The local node did not become ready. Open the logs for details, then restart the app after resolving the issue.
conversation.clearHistoryConfirm: This permanently erases this conversation's messages on this device. It can't be undone and doesn't affect the other person's copy.
conversation.noPeersHint: Mesh-Talk searches your local network. Keep both devices on the same LAN.
conversation.unreadUnavailable: This message is outside the history available on this device.
conversation.peerCheckedDetail: Last checked a reachable member: {{time}}. Offline members may have more messages.

presence.lastSeenJustNow: Seen by this client just now
presence.offlineHint: Offline means this client has no valid online observation of this person. They may have exited, or this network may temporarily be unable to discover them.
presence.communicationHint: Online does not guarantee message delivery, file transfer, or calls. Discovery source does not establish physical location.
presence.knownOnlineHint: Known online is relative to this client. Accepted members are counted once per verified account, including you while your local node is running.
presence.queuePersistenceFailed: Automatic downloads can't be remembered across restarts: {{error}}
presence.unavailableDetail: Online indicators may be out of date. Previously seen devices will appear offline if their status cannot be refreshed. This does not mean they have signed out.
presence.requestTimeout: The online status request timed out after 10 seconds.
presence.invalidResponse: The online status response could not be read.

message.expiresIn: Expires in {{time}} after sending; removed on both sides

delivery.help: Automatic receipt from the target account. Not a read receipt.
delivery.fileHelp: File card delivered. File download and reading are separate.

custody.postOfficeHelp: The post office confirmed durable storage of this encrypted message. Recipient delivery, downloads and reading are separate.
custody.postOffice: Post office confirmed a stored copy
custody.help: Confirmed when an online member reported durable storage. Copies can later be lost; this is not a delivery or read receipt.

fail.peer-unknown: Couldn't send — recipient not reachable yet

message.deleteLocalDescription: This removes the message from this device only. Other participants keep their copies, and you can't undo this action.

transfer.awaitingRecipient: Waiting for file transfer to start…

composer.notQueued: Message not queued. Check the connection or pending sends, then try again.

screenshot.permission: Screen capture needs the Screen Recording permission. Grant it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, then restart Mesh-Talk.
screenshot.editorHint: Drag to select an area. Enter to finish · Esc to cancel
screenshot.editorHintSelected: Annotate the selected area, then send.
screenshot.invalidImage: The captured image could not be opened. Try again.
screenshot.unavailable: Screen capture is unavailable in this desktop session.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage privacy, appearance, messages, files, and app behavior.
settings.launchAtLoginDesc: Start Mesh-Talk in the background when you sign in.
settings.closeToTrayDesc: Closing the window hides it to the tray instead of quitting.
settings.notificationsDesc: Notify me about new messages when the window isn't focused.
settings.staySignedInDesc: Remember your password in the OS keychain to unlock automatically next launch.
settings.downloadFolderDesc: Attachments save to your system Downloads folder unless you choose another folder.
settings.downloadFolderSet: Received files are saved here automatically.
settings.retentionDesc: Automatically erase messages older than this from this device.
settings.callsDesc: Enable 1:1 voice and video calls. Experimental: LAN-only and may be unreliable.
settings.ringtoneDesc: The sound for incoming calls. Pick one to preview it.
settings.postOfficeDesc: Use an available LAN relay for offline delivery. Event details are encrypted, but relays can infer contacts from connections and timing. Turning this off stops relay uploads and downloads on this device.
settings.postOfficeSendDesc: Allow encrypted messages, files, receipts and consent controls to be uploaded to relays. Turning this off keeps pending outgoing work on this device.
settings.postOfficeReceiveDesc: Allow encrypted data to be retrieved from relays. Receiving files and confirming delivery also require sending consent and receipt controls. Direct peer transfers remain available.
settings.discoveryScopeLocalDesc: Discover devices through recognized physical Ethernet and Wi-Fi interfaces. Routed discovery and post-office directories are inactive. Existing authorized connections remain available.
settings.discoveryScopeRoutedDesc: Also discover devices over existing networks such as Tailscale and EasyTier when their local clients are available. You can add an address manually. Post-office discovery is controlled separately.
settings.physicalLanOnlyDesc: Discover devices only through physical local interfaces. Disables routed-network discovery and post-office directories; explicitly authorized existing connections remain available.
settings.bridgeDiscovery: Discover peers through a post office
settings.bridgeDiscoveryDesc: Share this device's public presence with reachable bridge-enabled post offices and discover participants across networks. Messages use encrypted relay mailboxes when peers cannot connect directly. This is off by default and unavailable in invisible mode.
settings.bridgeHubDesc: Choose a directly reachable post office on your LAN or through a routed network. Another available relay takes over if your choice is offline; cross-network delivery still needs an onward route.
settings.bridgeHubRemote: Saved relay without a direct route: {{name}}
settings.privacyLevelDesc: Changes screen, notification and clipboard protections. Network visibility and relay permissions are configured separately.
settings.notificationPreviewDesc: Include sender and message text in system notifications.
settings.autoLockDesc: Hide chats after the selected period of inactivity.
settings.lockWhenHiddenDesc: Immediately lock when the app is hidden, unless a call is active.
settings.confirmCopyDesc: Ask before copying a message or link code.
settings.confirmCopyPrompt: Copy this sensitive text to the clipboard?
settings.clipboardClearDesc: Only clear text if the clipboard still holds this app’s copy. If clipboard access is unavailable, nothing is cleared.
settings.lockedDescription: Messages stay available after you unlock. Background delivery continues.
settings.useTouchId: Use Touch ID or Mac password
settings.mediaMigrationWarning: Some older media could not be encrypted. The original files remain readable. Free disk space or check permissions, then restart to retry. Existing backups may still hold plaintext.
settings.exportLimit: Files you save and text you copy leave the encrypted app store; the operating system and other apps may access them.
settings.managedDeviceLimit: A company-managed device may observe the screen, input, files, and network activity. These settings reduce app-created exposure; they cannot prevent device monitoring.
settings.scopeAccount: Saved for this account on this device.
settings.appearanceSyncHint: Appearance can sync when enabled in linked-device settings.
settings.presetEffects: This preset changes message previews, automatic lock, lock when hidden, copy confirmation and clipboard clearing. It does not change network visibility, relay permissions or history retention.
settings.previewSettingsLink: Manage message previews in Notifications & calls
settings.relayDisabledReason: Inactive because post-office relays are off. Your saved preference is kept.
settings.physicalOnlyReason: Inactive while discovery is limited to the local network.
settings.invisibleReason: Inactive while Invisible mode is on.
settings.privacyUnknownReason: Network privacy is still loading or unavailable.
settings.partialReceiveWarning: Receiving through post offices without sending can prevent file consent and delivery confirmations. Direct transfers remain available.
settings.previewDisabledReason: Inactive while notifications are off. Your saved preference is kept.
settings.relayPreferenceHint: This is a saved preference, not proof of the relay currently in use. Other eligible relays remain available for fallback.
settings.retentionConfirmDesc: Messages older than {{count}} days will be deleted from this device immediately. Increasing this limit later will not restore deleted history. Other devices and backups are not erased.
settings.attachmentOverrides: Individual conversations can override this receiving default from their attachment settings.
settings.refreshFailed: The change was saved, but its current value could not be reloaded: {{error}}. Reload settings to confirm.
settings.presetPending: Applying a preset changes the five protections listed below. Individual changes use Custom.
settings.presetNotApplied: Preset selection is not applied yet.

search.title: Search messages
search.failed: Search could not finish. Try again.
search.outsideRecent: This match is outside recent messages. Open Chat history above to find it.

history.title: Chat history
history.description: Search and browse everything in your conversation with {{name}}.

files.alreadyDownloaded: Already downloaded — use Reveal to find it.
files.noDefaultFolder: Saving to your system Downloads folder
files.approvalRequired: Waiting for your approval to receive this attachment.
files.contactReceiveMode: Files and folders from this contact
files.receiveModeDesc: Choose whether attachments start transferring automatically. Images, stickers, and messages arrive normally.
files.contactReceiveDesc: This contact's setting overrides the global default.
files.largeVideo: Large video — save it, then open externally.
files.videoUnsupported: This video can't be previewed here — use Save to open it in your player.
files.imageUnsupported: This image can't be previewed here — use Save to open it.
files.description: Attachments shared with you in conversations.

linkDevice.historySyncDescription: Share and receive available direct and channel messages and file information with your linked devices.
linkDevice.attachmentsSyncDescription: Share and download available file bytes with linked devices. File information also syncs with message history.
linkDevice.profileSyncDescription: Receive avatar changes from your linked devices.
linkDevice.appearanceSyncDescription: Share theme and wallpaper choices with linked devices.
linkDevice.contactsSyncDescription: Share contact pins, aliases, and visibility choices.
linkDevice.title: Your devices
linkDevice.showOnOther: On your other device, create a local profile and sign in first. Then generate a code here and enter it there. Linking makes both devices share this account.
linkDevice.qrHint: Scan the QR with a phone, or copy the code and enter it on your other device.
linkDevice.enterCodeHint: Enter this code on your other device, below.
linkDevice.haveCode: Have a code from your other device?
linkDevice.linked: Linked! This device now shares that account.
linkDevice.rotateIdentity: Rotate to a fresh account identity.
linkDevice.legacyFileMetadata: Upgrade this linked device to sync file information separately from file downloads.

webrtcTest.title: Voice / video self-test
webrtcTest.description: Check whether this build's webview can use the camera, microphone, and WebRTC. Run it once on each platform (macOS, Windows, Linux).
webrtcTest.connectDetail: Peer connection established (host candidates, no STUN/TURN).
webrtcTest.mediaDetail: Live media frames flowing through WebRTC.
webrtcTest.timeout: Timed out waiting for the connection.
webrtcTest.candidatesHint: On a LAN, host candidates are enough — no STUN/TURN needed.
webrtcTest.loopbackNote: A pass proves this webview supports getUserMedia + WebRTC on this machine. Calling another device additionally depends on the LAN (AP isolation / firewall can block direct media).

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: See LAN discovery working: who is found, your identity, and the network.
diagnostics.name: Name
diagnostics.noPeers: No peers discovered yet. Make sure another device is on the same LAN.
diagnostics.noActivity: No discovery activity yet. Appearances/disappearances will show here.
diagnostics.troubleshootHint: If peers don't appear, your firewall may block LAN discovery. Allow UDP {{udp}} (multicast discovery) and TCP {{tcp}} (this session). Make sure both devices are on the same network.
diagnostics.macosFirewall: System Settings → Network → Firewall: allow incoming connections for Mesh-Talk, or turn the firewall off on a trusted LAN.
diagnostics.rescanHint: Re-announce this device and rescan the LAN immediately.

verify.title: Verify contact
verify.description: Compare this safety number with {{name}} over a trusted channel (in person, a phone call). If it matches, there is no one in the middle.
verify.verifiedBanner: You verified the current safety number for {{name}}.
verify.prompt: Compare the safety number below with this contact over a trusted channel, then mark them verified.
verify.changedDesc: Their device fingerprint differs from what you first saw. This happens when they add or replace a device — but it can also be an impostor. Re-verify before trusting it.
verify.offline: This contact isn't currently online, so its fingerprint can't be shown.

members.replicaHelp: Sharing helps members recover missed messages and saved attachments from this device. Turning it off does not stop incoming messages.
members.title: Members
members.dissolveConfirm: Dissolve this channel for everyone? Members will keep their history, but no one can send messages or change members afterward.
members.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from this channel? They will not receive new messages after the membership update reaches the group.
members.confirmTransfer: Make {{name}} the channel owner? They will manage membership and the channel name.
members.confirmLeave: Leave this channel? You will stop receiving new messages. Your local history remains on this device.
members.transferBeforeLeave: Transfer ownership to another member before you leave this channel.

createChannel.title: New channel
createChannel.description: Invite devices to a channel. Each device must accept before joining; another device on the same account needs its own invitation.
createChannel.failed: Couldn't create the channel: {{error}}. Try again.

about.title: About
about.tagline: Encrypted, peer-to-peer messaging over your local network.
about.credits: Animated stickers from Google's Noto Emoji, used under their open-source license.

updates.title: Updates
updates.manual: Check for a newer release in your selected channel. You choose when to download and install it.
updates.verified: Download verified and ready to install
updates.noPackage: A package for this device is not available in this release. See the release page for options.

install.mac: Unzip the download, open the DMG, then drag Mesh-Talk to Applications. Quit the current app before replacing it. Your local data stays in place.
install.windows: Unzip the download and run the EXE installer (or MSI for managed installs). Close Mesh-Talk first. Your local data stays in place.
install.linux: Unzip the download, then install the DEB or RPM package for your distribution, or run the AppImage. Close Mesh-Talk first. Your local data stays in place.

updates.nightlyWarning: Experimental builds may contain bugs. Choose Nightly to try upcoming features.
updates.stableHelp: Stable receives official releases. Switching channels never automatically downgrades the app.

offlineConnect.title: Connect without Wi-Fi
offlineConnect.intro: No router or internet needed. One device shares a hotspot, the other joins — Mesh-Talk finds it automatically, and messages stay end-to-end encrypted.
offlineConnect.introNoNetwork: This device isn't on any network yet. No router or internet needed — one device shares a hotspot, the other joins, and Mesh-Talk links them automatically with messages still end-to-end encrypted.
offlineConnect.hostMac: macOS: System Settings → General → Sharing → Internet Sharing (or turn on Personal Hotspot).
offlineConnect.hostWin: Windows: Settings → Network & Internet → Mobile hotspot.
offlineConnect.hostLinux: Linux: network menu → Turn On Wi-Fi Hotspot.
offlineConnect.joinBody: Connect the second device to that hotspot, then reopen Mesh-Talk. You'll appear in each other's list within seconds — or open Network diagnostics and tap Rescan.
offlineConnect.wiredNote: No Wi-Fi at all? An Ethernet cable or USB tethering between the two devices works the same way.
offlineConnect.manualBody: Already on a VPN or another reachable network? Enter the other device's IP address or hostname. Mesh-Talk will verify its identity before connecting.
offlineConnect.manualSent: Discovery query sent. The device will appear when it responds and its identity is verified.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your photo and name as others see them.
profile.usernameHint: You sign in with this username — it can't be changed. The display name above is just a nickname and can be changed anytime.

errorBoundary.title: Mesh-Talk hit a display error.
errorBoundary.description: Reload the app to continue. Your messages are stored locally.

redesign.noPeersBody: Mesh-Talk looks for people on the same local network. Keep both devices open and on that network.
redesign.connectIntro: Mesh-Talk discovers people on a shared local network. Both devices need to be open and connected.
redesign.sameNetworkBody: Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi or wired network, then announce this device to look for each other now.
redesign.announceFeedback: This device announced itself. Keep Mesh-Talk open on both devices while they discover each other.
redesign.emptyConversation: Start the conversation with a message.
redesign.firstRun: New here? Create an identity on this device, then find people on your local network.
redesign.discoveryHint: This device keeps its own keys. Mesh-Talk finds people on your local network.
redesign.wallpaperDesc: Show the image behind messages in personal themes.
redesign.returning: Sign in to unlock this device’s identity and conversations.
redesign.slowStartup: Opening encrypted stores is taking longer than usual. You can check connection details while Mesh-Talk continues starting.
redesign.keyboardHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
redesign.identityStep: Create an identity that stays on this device.
redesign.discoveryStep: Sign in, then find people on the same local network.

packs.noThemes: No personal themes installed. Install one below to personalize the app.

trustCard.publicProfileStatementsSignedByThisAccou: Public profile statements signed by this account. A valid signature does not establish a person's identity or your trust in them.
trustCard.noSignedCardAvailableAccountCreationDate: No signed card available. Account creation date is unknown.
trustCard.thisQRCodeContainsOnlyTheAccount: This QR code contains only the account ID.
trustCard.publishingIncludesYourCurrentSharedAvata: Publishing includes your current shared avatar.
trustCard.signaturesIdentifyTheIssuingAccountsEval: Signatures identify the issuing accounts. Evaluate those accounts independently. Introductions are statements, and witnesses record observation; neither automatically verifies this contact.
trustCard.thisRecordsThatYouObservedThisSigned: This records that you observed this signed creation claim now. It does not confirm when the account was created.
trustCard.importASignedCardOrProof: Import a signed card or proof
trustCard.signaturesAndAccountBindingsAreCheckedBe: Signatures and account bindings are checked before import. Local verification and private observation history are never imported or exported.
trustCard.thePublishedCreationDateIsFixed: The published creation date is fixed.
trustCard.leaveBlankToKeepTheCreationDate: Leave blank to keep the creation date unknown.
